hook: Your evening at Wagah shows two countries lowering flags face to face.
title: India And Pakistan Face Off Every Evening
description:
Every evening at the Wagah border near Amritsar, Indian and Pakistani border forces perform a flag-lowering ceremony facing each other. Crowds gather on both sides to watch it.

#Shorts #India #Geography
comment_prompt: Have you been to Wagah? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your evening at Wagah shows two countries lowering flags together.
scenes.headline: FLAGS LOWER TOGETHER

scenes.narration: It happens near Amritsar, at sunset, every day.
scenes.headline: EVERY SUNSET

scenes.narration: Soldiers from both sides march toward the gate.
scenes.headline: MARCHING TO THE GATE

scenes.narration: They stamp, high-kick and stare each other down.
scenes.headline: THE HIGH KICK FACE-OFF

scenes.narration: Crowds on both sides cheer and chant.
scenes.headline: CROWDS ON BOTH SIDES

scenes.narration: Then the gates open and both flags come down.
scenes.headline: GATES OPEN, FLAGS DOWN

scenes.narration: The gates close again, until tomorrow evening.
scenes.headline: GATES CLOSE AGAIN

scenes.narration: That's the daily flag face-off at Wagah.
scenes.headline: WAGAH FACE-OFF
